question: In a certain code language, if GLOWING is written as GGILNOW, then how will OBVIOUS be written as in the same code language?
solution:
The table is alphabets place value:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

All alphabets are arranged in ascending order (i.e. alphabetical order A to Z).

GLOWING is written as GGILNOW;

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc04c7877c7449516aecbd4ae1299767c371da91acb568a6aec8cd546f514b31.png] 

Similarly,

OBVIOUS = ?

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/90f561a69d1757a43e59690573f43bd0fbdb95c4442cdeb6316bf12e0207a0c2.png] 

Hence, 'OBVIOUS' is coded as "**BIOOSUV**".
